file.name: README.md
file.content:
# aibo

Persistent manager and worker conversations
in an Emacs workspace.

## Interface

Full mode has three panels: notifications, main content,
and global input.
M-0 starts a new manager chat.
M-1 through M-9 select recent bots.
cb0 through cb9 select recent managers.
Locations and projects are read-only reference pages.
The assistant manages their data and project instructions.
